run.paths: Paths are recorded relative to the repository root. A tool that lived outside the checkout is shown as <external>/<filename>; its identity is fixed by binary_sha256, which is unmodified and is what a reviewer checks. The absolute paths of the machine that ran this are not a property of the run.

cdxgen.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. The 2026-08-23 run invokes the pinned image ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:12.8.2 through tools/cdxgen-docker.sh; the 2026-07-27, 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-01 runs used a node_modules install of the same version.

pqprobe-static.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. Built from source at 3.5.0, CGO_ENABLED=0, -ldflags '-s -w'. Maintained by the same party as Proofstein; see the governance section in README.md.

withheld_cboms.reason: Holdout CBOMs carry the variants' file paths, line numbers and matched source lines. Publishing them would republish most of what the unpublished seed protects (METHODOLOGY.md §6), so they are archived privately and committed here only as digests.
